blocks.text: Thus I told Murray that I would narrate everything: the year, the age, the land, and the place. (1)
It was in Talwandi of Rai Bhoe near Lahore that Guru Nanak was born. (2)
He was born in the Bedi Khatri lineage, in a family of deep piety. (3)
In Kaliyuga, when rulers had become butchers and righteousness seemed to fly away, the Guru took birth to restore the path. (43 and transition)
